  have hf_norm : ∀ i, ‖z ^ (i + 1) * a i‖ ≤ g i := by
    intro i
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, one_mul]
    exact hdom i
  have hf_sum : Summable (fun i => z ^ (i + 1) * a i) :=
    Summable.of_norm_bounded hsummable hf_norm
  have ht : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 (∑' i, z ^ (i + 1) * a i)) := by
    rw [h]
    exact hf_sum.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  exact ⟨_, ht, fun y hy => tendsto_nhds_unique hy ht⟩
